errors.text_span: достига точно стойността от 10 000 млн. лв.
errors.evidence: The bar for the year 2007 is visibly slightly below the 10,000 gridline. The description's claim that it reaches 'exactly' (точно) 10,000 is incorrect.

The description identifies 2001 and 2019 as having the shortest bars, but omits the year 2020, which has a bar of a similarly low height to 2019. This is an incomplete description of the data's minimums.
